attempted_workload.note: Local JVM block artifacts are retained in manifest.evidence. Scala log records mining a three-transaction block at 724; full mined block JSON was not captured before the paired-node wait failed.

divergence.classification: mining integration; no demonstrated cost-validation mismatch
divergence.trigger: Both nodes accept a funding-only block that leaves the emission box unspent. Rust treats its first ordinary output as the next emission box; Scala retains the actual emission box.
divergence.rust_error: EmissionInvariant: emission box value 1000000000 < per-block emission 67500000000 at h=724
divergence.scala_observation: Built a height-724 candidate and mined block 1de5e19bf4fc822b2a6921ffd929b2ad885e6cf011a181d6be2e4d8152445a33.
divergence.separate_transport_limitation: Both nodes report peersCount=0 at the final observation. Scala height 724 versus Rust height 723 is a propagation timeout, not evidence that Rust rejected this block.

not_executed.rust-mines: Stopped per controller ruling after the emission-discovery divergence.
not_executed.live_cap_injections: No live sum==cap, sum==cap+1 or single-tx-at-cap injections occurred; JVM preflight is not L6 closure.

observed.rejection_detail: Scripts of all transaction inputs should pass verification. 2210b193ac45836c688b8b382679cfc10739af515b8d3c037747cfab01c5b75a: #0 => Failure(sigma.exceptions.CostLimitException: Estimated execution cost 403 exceeds the limit 402)

The live warm-up timestamp was not separately captured; individual generated block timestamps and all paired commitments are retained.
